name: @grocery/database
description: Shared PostgreSQL connection pool, Kysely client, transaction helpers, and migration runner

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; if (fs.existsSync('src/migrations')) { fs.cpSync('src/migrations', 'dist/migrations', { recursive: true }); }"
